issue: 33 previously positioned Gandhi historical group records lost exact text alignment after retranslation.
fix: Fallback locates historical line range inside a SHA-256-verified original backup, then requires identical complete non-text command stream, equal group count and matching group command signature before mapping to current group. Historical exclusion ordinal is never used as the locator.
scope: Only historical kind=group records satisfying all proofs. Other unresolved entries remain unresolved.
